ledger.x: c. 600 BCE: the Kamboja janapada, one of the Mahajanapadas, holds the cis-Hindukush country from Nuristan to Rajouri, with Rajapura as capital. c. 530 BCE: Cyrus destroys the Kamboja city of Kapisi (Begram). 'Cyrus II is said to have destroyed the famous Kamboja city called Kapisi (modern Begram) in Paropamisade' (undated). c. 501 BCE: Kamboja is absorbed into the Achaemenid Empire. 'Kamboja and Gandhara formed the twentieth and richest satrapy of the Achaemenid Empire' (undated). wars.name: Achaemenid conquest of the Indus Valley
wars.outcome: Persian conquest from 'around 535 BCE' under Cyrus and a second push 'around 518 BCE' under Darius, to the Jhelum; the Kambojas are named only as a belligerent in the page's infobox.
